empty.hint: Desktop auto-scans this computer. To use another machine — a server, dev box, or any computer with a terminal — add it here.

no_matches.title: No matches
no_matches.try_widening: Try widening the scope or clearing filters.

bootstrapping.title: Starting local runtime…
bootstrapping.hint: This usually takes a few seconds. Your daemon is registering with the workspace.

machine.no_matches_hint: No machines match the current search or filter.
machine.select_machine: Select a machine to inspect its runtimes.
machine.select_runtime: Built-in runtimes appear automatically. Select one for settings, or add a custom command.
machine.no_runtimes_hint: Start or reconnect this machine's daemon. Its installed CLI runtimes will appear here automatically.
machine.not_found_hint: It may be offline, removed, or no longer available to you.

rename_dialog.title: Rename machine
rename_dialog.description: Give this machine a name you'll recognize. It applies to every runtime on this machine and shows up when you pick a runtime for an agent.
rename_dialog.hint: Leave empty to use the device's default name.

online.label: Online
online.description: Heartbeat received in the last 45s. Ready to dispatch tasks.

recently_lost.label: Recently lost
recently_lost.description: Lost contact under 5 minutes ago — often a brief network blip.

offline.label: Offline
offline.description: No heartbeat for 5+ minutes. Restart the daemon or investigate the host.

about_to_gc.label: About to GC
about_to_gc.description: Offline 6+ days. Auto-deleted at 7 days unless it reconnects.

detail.no_agents: No agents are bound to this runtime yet.

visibility_hint.private: Only you and workspace admins can create agents on this runtime.
visibility_hint.public: Any workspace member can create agents on this runtime.

delete_dialog.self_heal_notice: This runtime is managed by a running local daemon. Deleting it will succeed, but the daemon will re-register a fresh runtime within seconds — stop the daemon process first to remove it permanently.
delete_dialog.profile_backed_notice: This runtime was registered from a custom runtime profile. Deleting it removes only the current runtime instance; a running daemon can register it again while the profile remains. Delete the custom runtime profile from Custom runtimes to remove it permanently.

light.title: Delete Runtime?
light.description: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.

cascade.title_one: Archive {{count}} agent and delete this Runtime?
cascade.title_other: Archive {{count}} agents and delete this Runtime?

cascade.warning: This is destructive. Archived agents will be removed from active workflows and their queued or running tasks will be cancelled.
cascade.notice_runtime_has_active_agents: Active agents were added since you opened this dialog. Review the new plan and confirm.
cascade.notice_runtime_delete_plan_changed: The active agent set changed while this dialog was open. Review the new plan and confirm.
cascade.checkbox_one: I understand this {{count}} agent will be archived and any queued or running tasks will be cancelled.
cascade.checkbox_other: I understand these {{count}} agents will be archived and any queued or running tasks will be cancelled.

detail_page.not_found_hint: It may have been deleted or you may not have access.

connect.title: Add a computer
connect.description: Run these two commands on the computer you want to add. We'll detect it the moment the daemon comes online.
connect.step2_hint: Opens a browser to sign in, then keeps the daemon running in the background.
connect.live_listening_hint: We'll detect it as soon as the daemon starts — usually under a minute.
connect.troubleshooting: Can't open a browser on that computer?
connect.trouble_intro: Use a token instead of the browser sign-in. This replaces step 2 and works anywhere you have a terminal.
connect.trouble_token_hint_suffix: . The daemon only makes outbound connections — no inbound ports required.
connect.success_description: Your computer is online and ready. Create an agent and it can start picking up tasks here.

cloud_runtime.title: Cloud Runtime
cloud_runtime.description: Launch a managed cloud node and watch its Fleet status.
cloud_runtime.create_hint: Choose a name, instance type, and disk size. Fleet applies the rest.
cloud_runtime.nodes_failed_hint: Fleet did not return a node list.
cloud_runtime.toast_create_failed: Failed to create Cloud Runtime node
cloud_runtime.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this cloud node? This action cannot be undone.

validation.disk_size_invalid: Disk size must be a positive integer

fc_e2b_runtime.title: Add Cloud Sandbox
fc_e2b_runtime.description: Choose Alibaba Cloud FC or Aone Sandbox and create an independent cloud sandbox runtime.
fc_e2b_runtime.toast_create_failed: Failed to create cloud sandbox runtime
fc_e2b_runtime.visibility_hint: Private runtimes can only be used by you and workspace admins. Public runtimes can be used by any workspace member.
fc_e2b_runtime.provider_hint: The agent CLI this runtime runs. The selected template must include it.
fc_e2b_runtime.backend_aliyun_fc_hint: Runs the selected E2B template on Alibaba Cloud FC.
fc_e2b_runtime.backend_asb_hint: Supports BUC single sign-on, a1, and mw. Agents must bind an Alibaba employee identity.
fc_e2b_runtime.stable_uninitialized: The stable channel is not initialized yet.
fc_e2b_runtime.candidate_hint: Candidate runtimes do not follow stable upgrades and are only for pre-release validation.
fc_e2b_runtime.candidate_asb_hint: Use the immutable image ref and digest produced by Aone CI. The server runs a native ASB smoke test before creation.

fc_e2b_stable.title: FC/E2B stable version
fc_e2b_stable.description: Verify an immutable candidate and update developer allow-list runtimes first. After developer approval, manually start the 24-hour 5%, 25%, 50%, and 100% rollout.
fc_e2b_stable.description_asb: Verify an immutable image from Aone CI and update developer ASB runtimes first. After identity-enabled checks, manually start the same 24-hour rollout.
fc_e2b_stable.bootstrap_notice: The stable channel is not initialized. This validates and records the current stable template without changing runtimes. After it completes, choose another candidate to start a rollout.
fc_e2b_stable.bootstrap_notice_asb: The ASB stable channel is not initialized. This validates and records the immutable image without changing runtimes.
fc_e2b_stable.validation_notice: The server rechecks the template ID, build ID, and READY state, runs the smoke test in a native sandbox, and strictly validates the runtime manifest, all three runtimes, capabilities, component versions, and launch protocol.
fc_e2b_stable.validation_notice_asb: The server verifies the image digest and commit, starts a native ASB sandbox, and validates the runtime manifest before accepting the release.
fc_e2b_stable.artifact_hint_asb: The image reference must end with the same sha256 digest. Use the full 40-character source commit.
fc_e2b_stable.awaiting_rollout_notice: Developer runtimes are updated. Complete real conversation checks, then manually start the 24-hour rollout.
fc_e2b_stable.rollout_schedule_hint: All times stay anchored to rollout start. Manual advance opens the next stage early without moving any scheduled time.
fc_e2b_stable.complete_observation_notice: Complete the release after final checks. The server rechecks every Runtime and health gate, then marks this template as the current stable version and exits the active release.
fc_e2b_stable.rollback_notice: Rollback switches only the runtimes updated by this release back to {{template}}; runtimes not yet updated stay unchanged. Running tasks continue, while later messages and new tasks use a new sandbox from the rollback template.

fc_e2b_stable_overview.title: All-workspace Runtime overview
fc_e2b_stable_overview.heading: All-workspace Runtime overview
fc_e2b_stable_overview.description: See every workspace's cloud sandbox runtimes, immutable artifacts, health, and stable-channel convergence in one place.
fc_e2b_stable_overview.load_failed_description: The stable channel or Runtime data could not be loaded.
fc_e2b_stable_overview.forbidden_description: Only users in the stable-release developer allow-list can view the all-workspace Runtime overview.
fc_e2b_stable_overview.current_stable_description: The completed stable-channel artifact pointer applied to stable runtimes.
fc_e2b_stable_overview.current_stable_empty: The stable channel has not been initialized.
fc_e2b_stable_overview.active_release_description: Live status for the developer update or 24-hour rollout.
fc_e2b_stable_overview.no_active_release: No stable release is currently active.
fc_e2b_stable_overview.templates_description: {{count}} artifact versions are in use. Select one to filter runtimes.
fc_e2b_stable_overview.search_placeholder: Search workspace, Runtime, artifact, or build ID...
fc_e2b_stable_overview.no_matches_hint: Change the search query or clear filters and try again.

fc_e2b_template_update.title: Change cloud sandbox image
fc_e2b_template_update.description: Switch this runtime to another ready FC/E2B template without changing its provider or agent bindings.
fc_e2b_template_update.cutover_notice: Running tasks stay on their current sandbox. Later tasks and new messages will create a sandbox from the new image.
fc_e2b_template_update.toast_failed: Failed to update cloud sandbox image

list.delete_permission_hint: Only the runtime owner and workspace admins can delete this runtime
list.delete_admin_hint: Only the runtime owner and workspace admins can delete a runtime.

profiles.unassigned_description: These workspace runtimes are not connected to any machine. Connect a machine with the matching commands, or use a row's actions to edit or delete them.
profiles.dialog_description: Custom runtime definitions are workspace-wide and sync to every connected machine. A machine registers the runtime when the command is available there.
profiles.create_dialog_description: Set up a custom command from {{machine}}. The definition syncs workspace-wide and registers only on machines where that command is available.
profiles.builtin_section_hint: Built-in families are read-only reference options.
profiles.empty_description: Pick a base protocol family, then point Multica at the command to run.

builtin_detail.title: Built-in protocol family
builtin_detail.description: {{family}} is a built-in protocol family. It can't be edited or removed.

detail.default_description: Pick one from the list to see its details.

form.step_family_hint: The underlying CLI protocol this runtime speaks.
form.family_locked_hint: The base protocol family can't be changed after creation.
form.error_command_trailing_escape: Complete or remove the trailing backslash before saving.
form.error_command_shell_syntax: Shell pipelines, redirects, and control operators are not supported. Use a wrapper script for that.
form.error_command_shell_expansion: Shell variable and command expansion is not supported. Use an absolute path or wrapper script.
form.error_duplicate_name: A runtime with this display name already exists.

delete_dialog.title: Delete custom runtime from workspace?
delete_dialog.description: "{{name}}" will be removed from this workspace and every machine where it is registered. This can't be undone.
delete_dialog.error_bound: This runtime can't be deleted while agents are still using it.
